content:
Apple TV has a Black Friday deal now available that lets new and returning subscribers get the service for just $6.99/month for up to six months (normally $14.99/month). Here are the details.

You can get Apple TV for just $6.99/month for up to six months with Black Friday deal

If you’ve been waiting for the right time to re-subscribe to Apple TV, now is the time.

Apple is offering its best deal of the year for Black Friday, and it’s available now through November 30.

Subscribe to Apple TV today and you’ll pay just $6.99/month for up to 6 months.

You can subscribe to Apple TV here.

The Black Friday price is heavily discounted compared to the standard $14.99/month price. And you can cancel the subscription at any time, there’s no need to keep it for the full six months.

The offer is valid for both new and returning subscribers, but you have to subscribe before Monday, November 30 at 8:00 p.m. PT.

Apple typically doesn’t discount Apple TV except for its Black Friday deal, so this is the best price that will likely be available until late 2027.

What’s new and coming soon to Apple TV

Here’s a rundown of everything Apple TV has recently premiered, and what’s coming soon.

Apple TV’s current shows include the hit crime thrillers Nocturne and 12 12 12, one of which involves a serial killer while the other centers on a heist. Owen Wilson’s beloved comedy Stick is also now airing its second season, which sees Pluribus star Rhea Seehorn join the cast.

Chris Pratt’s film Way of the Warrior Kid just premiered too, joining several recent movie debuts including a ton of classic favorites.

If you haven’t been an Apple TV subscriber in a while, noteworthy additions in recent months include:

  • Ted Lasso season 4, which aired late this summer
  • Widow’s Bay, the award-winning mystery series
  • New seasons for sci-fi hits Silo and Dark Matter
  • Small Prophets, a comedy hailed as perhaps Apple’s best new show of the year
  • Slow Horses recently wrapped up season 6

Looking ahead, December 2 brings the return of Bad Monkey, the excellent comedy from Ted Lasso and Shrinking’s creator. John Malkovich joins the cast, which is led by Vince Vaughn.

Apple already has a strong early 2027 slate set, headlined by major new sci-fi series Neuromancer which premieres in January. Also in January is The Wanted Man, a crime series starring Hugh Laurie, and She’s Fine, a new comedy with Elizabeth Banks and Ted Danson.

Which Apple TV shows and movies are you most interested in checking out? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for just $6.99/ month (over 50% off) for Black Friday. The discounted price lasts for up to six months.
